title: Shadow and colour walk
description: Take a short loop and notice five surprising colour combinations where sunlight meets walls, leaves, or pavement.
steps: Choose a familiar, well-lit loop.
Spot five colour-and-shadow pairings.
Return by the same safe route.
safety: Stay on public paths, watch traffic, and avoid photographing people without permission.

title: Doorstep sound map
description: Sit outdoors and map nearby sounds by direction and distance without recording anyone.
steps: Choose a sheltered seat or doorstep.
Mark sounds as near, middle, or far.
Circle one sound you had never noticed.
safety: Use a private balcony or safe public sitting area and do not record conversations.

title: Step-free texture safari
description: Find and sketch six outdoor textures such as brick, bark, stone, metal, moss, or cracked paint.
steps: Pick a paved, familiar route.
Pause at six distinct textures.
Sketch their patterns rather than touching unknown surfaces.
safety: Remain on accessible public paths and do not touch plants, sharp objects, or private property.

title: Cloud-frame break
description: Use a paper frame to watch one patch of sky change for ten quiet minutes.
steps: Choose a safe seat with a clear view upward.
Frame one patch of sky with your hands or paper.
Write three words for how it changed.
safety: Never look directly at the sun and move indoors if weather deteriorates.

title: Sheltered rain rhythm
description: Listen from a covered outdoor spot and identify repeating rain rhythms on three different surfaces.
steps: Stay under a solid shelter.
Compare rain on leaves, roofs, and pavement.
Tap back one rhythm, then head inside.
safety: Do not go out during thunder, lightning, flooding, strong wind, or freezing rain.

title: Tree-bark field notes
description: Compare the colour, pattern, and shape of three trees without guessing their species.
steps: Choose three trees beside a public path.
Describe bark pattern, colour, and branching.
Draw one thumbnail for each tree.
safety: Observe from the path, do not remove bark, and check for cyclists before stopping.

title: Accessible sensory roll
description: Follow a familiar smooth route and notice one sound, one colour, and one scent at each of three stops.
steps: Use a route you already know is smooth and accessible.
Pause at three safe stopping points.
Record one sound, colour, and scent at each.
safety: Use a known accessible route; this app does not verify curb cuts, gradients, or closures.

title: Balcony micro-garden check
description: Inspect one container plant, remove debris, check soil moisture, and note one small change.
steps: Choose one familiar container plant.
Check soil moisture with a clean finger or meter.
Remove only loose debris and note one change.
safety: Do not taste unknown plants or handle mould, pesticides, or sharp tools without appropriate protection.

title: Neighbourhood architecture bingo
description: Find five public-facing design details: an arch, unusual brickwork, a dated cornerstone, a mural, and a decorative railing.
steps: Choose a familiar public route.
Find five details visible from the sidewalk.
Write a one-line guess about which is oldest, labelled clearly as a guess.
safety: Stay on public sidewalks and never enter private property to complete the list.

title: Public-art perspective swap
description: Visit one familiar public artwork with a partner and each describe a detail the other missed.
steps: Pick a familiar public artwork.
Observe silently for three minutes.
Trade one detail and one interpretation each.
safety: Choose a public, well-lit location and respect barriers around the artwork.

title: Tiny clean-up loop
description: Walk one short familiar block and safely collect only ordinary litter using proper protection.
steps: Choose one familiar public block.
Collect only safe ordinary litter with a grabber or gloved hand.
Seal the bag and wash your hands.
safety: Never touch needles, broken glass, chemicals, animal waste, or unknown objects; report hazardous waste instead.

title: Sunset palette from a safe seat
description: Watch changing evening colours from a familiar public or private spot and build a five-colour palette.
steps: Choose a familiar safe seat before dusk.
Name five colours as the light changes.
Leave before the route becomes uncomfortable or poorly lit.
safety: Do not look directly at the sun; use a familiar location and leave before dark if alone.

title: Park interval noticing
description: Alternate two minutes of brisk movement with one minute of slow observation on a familiar loop.
steps: Warm up for five minutes.
Repeat two minutes brisk and one minute slow observation.
Cool down and hydrate.
safety: Choose an intensity appropriate for you and stop for pain, dizziness, breathing difficulty, or unsafe conditions.

title: Partner gratitude walk
description: Take a device-light walk where each person shares three things they noticed and appreciated this week.
steps: Agree on a familiar public loop.
Each share one appreciation at three points.
Finish with one outdoor detail you both noticed.
safety: Keep the route public and familiar; remain aware of traffic and other path users.

title: Doorstep night-sky pause
description: From a safe private or familiar spot, let your eyes adjust and compare the brightest three objects in the sky.
steps: Use a safe private balcony or familiar doorstep.
Let your eyes adjust for five minutes.
Compare brightness and colour without guessing object names.
safety: Stay at a private or familiar well-lit access point and never walk into an unlit area to improve the view.

title: One-tree season change log
description: Revisit one public tree and record three observable changes without identifying species or making ecological claims.
steps: Choose a tree beside a familiar public path.
Record leaf, bark, and ground-level observations.
Date the note for a future comparison.
safety: Observe from the path and do not climb, break branches, or touch unknown plants.
